verdict.rationale: Daytona's docs and SDKs (Python/TypeScript/CLI) explicitly support programmatic sandbox creation, with docs claiming millisecond spin-up and $200 free compute to try it, plus snapshot/warm-pool mechanisms to further reduce startup latency. Independent community comments corroborate ease-of-use versus alternatives like DevPod, reinforcing the one-call provisioning experience. Missing for 10: no independent, quantitative benchmark confirming 'seconds' launch time in hands-on testing.
